# DevOpser Provider

Manages DevOpser Infrastructure Control, as the tfe provider manages Terraform Cloud.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    devopser = {
      source = "devopser-io/devopser"
    }
  }
}

# The token is an organization API key from Settings, API keys.
# Leave it out to use DEVOPSER_TOKEN, or the app.devopser.io entry in
# ~/.terraform.d/credentials.tfrc.json.
provider "devopser" {
  hostname = "app.devopser.io"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `hostname` (String) DevOpser hostname. Defaults to DEVOPSER_HOSTNAME, then app.devopser.io.
- `organization` (String) Accepted for tfe compatibility and ignored: the organization comes from the token.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) An organization API key. Defaults to DEVOPSER_TOKEN, then the CLI config credentials for the hostname (written by `tofu login`).
